Destroy Robot.descriptionOnly: no path: its +4 is on the save of a cyborg or android, which takes half damage; 12d6 + 1 a caster level (3d6 + 1 a caster level on a save) is rolled at the table

Magic Circle Against Technology.descriptionOnly: protection from technology's +2 deflection AC and +2 resistance on saves against technological attacks and effects; as protection from technology, for every creature in the area: against technological objects and robots only; its one save to suppress technological control is told here

Protection from Technology.descriptionOnly: against technological objects and robots only; the +2 morale on its new save against technological mental control, and its immunity to new control, are told here

Technomancy.descriptionOnly: only for a caster who already has the Technologist feat
